messages.subject: Std.all with ordered data
parts:
Hi there,

I have 8 binary variables. For CFA I used the following code :
fit <- cfa(model1, data=Nar1, ordered=names(Nar1))
My question is - would it be good idea to use standardization with my binary data?
Standardization suggestion:
summary(fit, fit.measures=TRUE, standardized=TRUE)

 Thank you for your help!
